# Duetto: converge

Audit the whole feature against its spec; unmet criteria become fix tasks (with your go-ahead), then a report is written.

1. The engine is in the sibling `duetto` skill: `duetto` below means `node "<skill-dir>/../duetto/engine/bin/duetto.mjs"`
   (`<skill-dir>` is this file's directory).
2. Run `duetto converge [--feature <NNN|slug>] --detach`, passing along what the user gave you.
3. Drive the run exactly as `<skill-dir>/../duetto/reference/loop.md` describes until its status is `paused` (this
   phase is complete) or `done`: synthesis steps, questions for the user, failures, everything.
4. Then tell the user what the phase produced, linking the files under `specs/NNN-*/` (report.md), and that
   the next step is nothing: the feature is done; offer to open a PR.
